messages:
Maya: Hey team — PR #2107 turned red in CI. Only the matrix axis `gpu:cuda-11.8` failed (test_eval_cache). I don't want to rerun the whole matrix. What's the shortest way to surgically retry that single job?

Jon: you can target the job with the CI bot. our usual pattern is: `/ci rerun --job buildkite:2107:matrix:gpu:cuda-11.8 --no-deps`

Jon: `--no-deps` will avoid rebuilding upstream steps and should reuse artifacts where possible. Full rerun recreates the whole graph.

Priya: if you prefer the web UI: open the failed job -> kebab menu (⋯) -> Rebuild -> check "Rebuild without dependencies". same effect.

Maya: is there a difference between `--no-deps` and something like `--rebuild-container`? I've seen both in scripts.

Jon: good question — `--no-deps` tells the bot to rerun that job without re-executing earlier pipeline steps. `--rebuild-container` is internal and just reconstructs the step container but may still pull fresh artifacts depending on the job configuration. For flake-first try `--no-deps`.

Tony: if it's likely a flaky test you can also retry the test inside the job without rerunning the job itself (if the runner supports it). we have a tiny helper: `./dev/ci/retry_test.sh --build 2107 --job gpu:cuda-11.8 --test test_eval_cache` — that attaches to the current job run and re-invokes the test harness.

Maya: I don't have permission to use `/ci` from my account. Do I ping someone?

Priya: mention `@ci-bot` with the command and the bot will validate and act on your behalf, e.g. `@ci-bot /ci rerun --job buildkite:2107:matrix:gpu:cuda-11.8 --no-deps`. If you can't, add `@eng-infra` and someone on call can trigger it.

ci-bot: Thanks! Request received from @Maya. Scheduling rerun for buildkite:2107:matrix:gpu:cuda-11.8 with mode=no-deps :gear:

Maya: got it, repo shows the job kicked off.

Jon: if the rerun fails again, paste the tail of the failing test log here (first ~100 lines) and we can decide next steps. Options: (1) retry test in-place, (2) run a small bisect, (3) mark as flaky and skip with ticket.

Tony: our bisect command is `bisect-ci --pr 2107 --test test_eval_cache --range main~30..HEAD` — that will try to narrow the commit that introduced the flake. It's heavier but useful if reruns keep failing.

infra-bot: Rerun started for buildkite:2107:matrix:gpu:cuda-11.8 — job 2107.5 :hourglass_flowing_sand:

infra-bot: Rerun complete — RESULT=failed (same test) :x:

Maya: ugh, still failing. I'll run the test-retry script once then kick off a bisect if it persists.

Tony: sounds good. if you do the bisect, include `--concurrency 4` so it doesn't overwhelm runners and ping @eng-infra.

Maya: done — ran `./dev/ci/retry_test.sh ...` — still failed. Starting bisect now and loop in infra.

Priya: tiny ask: add a one-line note to the PR with `flaky: test_eval_cache — retried job and bisected` so reviewers have context.

Maya: will add that and the bisect link. thanks all :rocket:
